business_summary: Platz Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells care beds, mattresses, and other add-on equipment in Japan. The company offers nursing care, hospital, and care facility beds, as well as mattresses and accessories. It is also involved in the sale of electric medical care beds and related equipment; and processing and sales of urethane foam. The company serves retailers of medical devices and nursing care goods, as well as furniture shops. The company was formerly known as Kyushu Waken ltd. and changed its name to Platz Co., Ltd. in June 1995. Platz Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Onojo, Japan.
